lessons_used: Reordering sign-in can be helpful (won after adoption selection at +5.5% and photo upload at +3.3%), but placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).
Redesigns and layout changes often showed no clear effect or caused severe negative drops (-17.2%), though the Stage Layout Pick Friend redesign was helpful (+7.1% won).
Desktop background notification prompts (+5.1% won) and path selection helper hints (+3.5% won) were helpful, but sound cues, notification toggles/banners, and overlay hints showed no clear effect.
Copy updates and waiting screen progress or time displays consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently over-optimistic for non-winning tests, predicting up to +12.0% where no clear effect was measured.
Predictions underestimated several winning tests, such as sign-in reordering (-8.0% predicted vs +3.3% measured), path helper hints (+0.2% vs +3.5%), and stage layout redesign (-5.0% vs +7.1%).

candidates.title: Pet Cloud Sync Security Highlight on Sign-In
candidates.change: Displays a prominent cloud save badge and reassuring sync message on the Sign-In screen clarifying that signing in secures pet progress across sessions.
candidates.why: Addresses the top support complaint (8 emails reporting pet data loss/reset on re-sign-in) while encouraging higher sign-in completion.

sign_in.headline: Sync & Protect Your Pet
sign_in.body: Create or sign into your account so your pet's memory, items, and growth are safely backed up to the cloud.

guard.reason: The cloud backup badge and copy clearly support the sign-in step without introducing pricing, dark patterns, or breaking any onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: High support evidence (8 emails) and low cost, though copy/incentive changes yield modest gains.

candidates.title: Personality Quiz Screen Before Path Selection
candidates.change: Inserts a new personality quiz screen ('new_personality_quiz') before path selection to help users decide between standard adoption and custom pet creation.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a long mean duration of 514s and 78.5% conversion; structured question prompts guide user decision making.

new_personality_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Companion
new_personality_quiz.body: Answer a quick question to help us suggest the perfect desktop pet experience for you.

components.label: What kind of desktop companion do you prefer?

guard.reason: 'new_personality_quiz.components[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

candidates.title: Story Screen Scroll Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the initial story screen layout to story_scroll with an animated companion mascot introducing the app experience.
candidates.why: Enhancing early engagement on the initial screen builds momentum before users hit path selection.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Discover how your new virtual pet lives right on your desktop, bringing fun interactions and daily company.

guard.reason: The scroll layout redesign introduces the desktop companion and fulfills the story screen's job without violating base rules.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Split Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the photo upload screen into a split layout featuring clear example visual card slots for standard photo framing.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected results; side-by-side visual examples improve photo quality and lower drop-off on adoption (64.1%).

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Photos
upload_photos.body: For best custom generation results, upload well-lit, front-facing photos of your pet.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen layout with example slots keeps its original function intact and remains fully compliant.

candidates.score_note: High impact step and support backing, but adoption redesigns consistently drop conversion (-4.9%).

candidates.title: Dedicated Pet Naming Screen in Adoption Flow
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated pet naming screen ('new_pet_naming') after pick_friend where users enter their pet's official name.
candidates.why: Adoption has the steepest funnel drop-off (64.1% conversion, 1017s mean time); early customization increases psychological ownership and completion.

new_pet_naming.headline: Give Your Pet a Name
new_pet_naming.body: Choose a name for your companion to personalize their adoption certificate.

guard.reason: Adding a dedicated pet naming screen inside the adoption flow is a valid addition that preserves all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen adds friction and historical new screens showed negative results (-2.2%).

candidates.title: Photo Accuracy Guidance Hint on Upload Screen
candidates.change: Adds a helpful hint banner on the photo upload screen explaining lighting and angle requirements.
candidates.why: Directly targets support tickets regarding failed or strange-looking custom pet generations (3 emails).

upload_photos.hint: Tip: Well-lit, close-up photos facing forward produce the most accurate 3D pet model.

guard.reason: Adding a helpful guidance tip to the upload photos screen is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Combines steep adoption drop, 3 support emails, and proven hint effectiveness (+3.5%).

candidates.title: Spotlight Layout Redesign for Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen into a spotlight layout showcasing an animated mascot hatching animation.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean time (2336s); a prominent visual focal point keeps users engaged while generation completes.

waiting.headline: Hatching Your Companion...
waiting.body: We are creating your pet's 3D model and animations. It will be ready on your desktop in just a moment!

guard.reason: The spotlight redesign for the waiting screen continues to show that the pet is being created.

candidates.score_note: Waiting screen redesigns and visual enhancements show no clear positive effect.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Check Screen Before Onboarding Finish
candidates.change: Adds a new screen ('new_visibility_check') right after home_intro where users confirm their pet is visible on the desktop.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on desktop or app opening issues, and finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.

new_visibility_check.headline: Check Your Desktop
new_visibility_check.body: Your pet should now be sitting near your screen corner or taskbar. Can you see your new friend?

guard.reason: Adding a desktop visibility check screen after home_intro is allowed under onboarding extension rules and retains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: High evidence but adding a new screen in finish step adds drop-off risk (-2.2% historically).

candidates.title: Home Intro Card Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns home_intro into a clean card layout with a high-visibility completion badge.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with long mean delays (5815s); a structured card design highlights setup completion clearly.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live!
home_intro.body: Congratulations! Your desktop companion is adopted and active on your computer screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro into a card layout with a completion badge is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Layout redesigns generally fail to improve target step performance.

candidates.title: Sign-In Centered Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a clean centered layout with a step progress indicator.
candidates.why: 2 support tickets noted sign-in stalling or failing to load cleanly; a simplified centered layout improves stability and sign-in completion.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Continue
sign_in.body: Connect your account to save your companion's certificate and progress.

guard.reason: Redesigning sign_in to a centered layout with a progress indicator retains the screen's core job and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints, but sign-in redesigns carry low historical success rates.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in (after adoption selection or photo upload) can be helpful, but placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).

Redesigns showed mixed results: while some caused severe negative drops (-17.2%, -8.6%) or no clear effect, specific redesigns like Stage Layout (+7.1% won) and Story Screen Scroll (+7.4% won) were helpful.

Desktop background notification prompts (+5.1% won), path helper hints (+3.5% won), and new screens like the desktop visibility check (+8.0% won) were helpful, but sound cues, notification toggles/banners, and overlay hints showed no clear effect.
Copy updates, incentives, and waiting screen progress or time displays consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently over-optimistic for tests with no clear effect, predicting gains up to +12.0%.
Predictions underestimated multiple winning tests, predicting negative or zero impact (-8.0% to +0.2%) on changes that ultimately won (+3.3% to +8.0%).
